_overall_length: Muzzle to buttplate, in metres. An M4A1 is 838mm with the stock out, and every other dimension of the model is in proportion to that, so one measured length sets the scale for all of them.
_axes: The viewmodel's +x, +y and -z, as axes of the file. This FBX is X-forward, Y-up, Z-across.
_max_texture: Sampled by a fixed-function pipeline on a gun that fills a fraction of the screen. Past this the extra detail is not resolvable and the file is twice the size.
_materials: The base colour each material draws with. The FBX links normal, roughness and metallic maps but no diffuse for the receiver, so the pairing is by name rather than by connection - stated here so a missing map is visible rather than silently flat. 'ao' is multiplied in; 'color' is the fallback tint for a material with no map on disk at all.
